integrity: The proof uses the published believed-public-announcement update exactly: every strict update eliminates all incoming labelled arrows to at least one active target, so the active-target set strictly decreases. A one-agent directed-cycle family with formula p and non-dead-end status attains the state-count bound exactly. The primary full text was inspected at Definition 5, Definition 8, Proposition 3, and the later single-agent K45 stabilization lemma. Targeted database and literature searches did not locate the state-count sharpening or its sharpness family.
scientific_limitations: The sharp lower-bound example is for general modal models, not for K45, KD45, or S5 frames. The theorem bounds update rounds on finite state spaces and does not give a finite bound for infinite state spaces or a complexity bound for formula evaluation.
title: Sharp state-count stabilization bound for finite believed announcements
